photo.creditHtml: Photo: PD-USGov, exact author unknown, Public domain

bat.answersHtml:
What is it?Mammal
Carnivore?Insects only

Many bats eat insects, but most of the rest eat fruit or nectar, and vampire bats feed on blood.

Dangerous?Can be

Bats carry diseases such as rabies, which makes handling them risky.

Domesticated?No
Awake when?Night
Hibernates?Yes

Bats in temperate regions hibernate or go into torpor; tropical bats don’t.

Kept as a pet?No
Do people eat it?In places

Bats are eaten in parts of Asia and Africa and on some Pacific and Caribbean islands.

content.profile:
Where it lives
Coasts of the northern and eastern North Pacific.
What it eats
Mostly sea urchins, molluscs, crustaceans and some fish. By eating urchins, it protects kelp forests.
Conservation
Endangered (IUCN Red List)
